messages.content: KEEPER Your Grace may enter now Cranmer approaches the council table CHANCELLOR My good lord Archbishop Im very sorry To sit here at this present and behold That chair stand empty But we all are men In our own natures frail and capable Of our fleshfew are angelsout of which frailty And want of wisdom you that best should teach us Have misdemeaned yourself and not a little Toward the King first then his laws in filling The whole realm by your teaching and your chaplains
